answer.rationale: Do not broadly counter the competitor with deeper promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment produced a 12% 30-day retention decline despite acquisition gains, which conflicts with sustainable qualified-revenue growth. Expand a measured referral incentive among established customers instead; it previously added qualified revenue without measurable retention harm. The current price-pressure environment may alter referral responsiveness, so keep this as a standard experiment with retention, referral quality, and incremental revenue guardrails rather than a broad rollout.
